profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at ITU AbsorbTech
profile.summary:
I honed my C# programming skills by modifying a Unity Game. To improve on those skills, I competed
with the features and security of other game modifiers. I have graduated with a bachelor's in Computer Science at the University of Wisconsin-Madison. I was also the Director of Engineering at Rubicon Technical Services, LLC. I am now a programmer analyst at the Medical College of Wisconsin performing impactful research.
